register: εσύ (informal singular, as Greek consumer health and wellness apps use; imperative in 2nd person singular: «Πάτησε», «Κατάγραψε»). Straight register: calm, plain, patient-leaflet Greek (terms as used by Greek public health sources and the Hellenic Menopause Society for the public). Wry register: dry, warm humour among friends, never crude. No exclamation marks. Greek quotation marks «…». Question mark is ';' (Greek erotimatiko); therefore never use ';' as a semicolon: English semicolons become a full stop or comma. Middle dot · kept as separator.
gender: Neutral constructions where possible. Where Greek marks the user's gender (adjectives/participles about the user: έτοιμη, σίγουρη, κουρασμένη), feminine forms are used. Clinician: «γιατρός» (common gender) with the generic article in running text («ο γιατρός σου», «με τον γιατρό σου»), or «επαγγελματίας υγείας» where a broader word is natural.

glossary.surge: κύμα (ουδ., πληθ. κύματα): «ένα κύμα», «3 κύματα», «Έχω ένα κύμα τώρα»
glossary.calm stretch: σερί ηρεμίας (μέρες στη σειρά χωρίς κύμα)
glossary.Apple Health: εφαρμογή Υγεία (Apple's Greek name of the Health app: «Υγεία»)
glossary.bleeding after menopause: αιμορραγία μετά την εμμηνόπαυση (after periods have stopped)
